Package gui

Class EntryControlController

java.lang.Object
gui.EntryControlController
public class EntryControlController extends Object
controller for the park employee entry-control screen (EntryControlFrame.fxml).

two tabs: Check-In Visitor (two modes: pre-booked and walk-in) and Register Exit. the check-in tab defaults to Pre-booked mode: employee enters a visitor ID, clicks "Find Booking" to preview today's confirmed order, then "Confirm Entry" to complete it. Walk-in mode collects visit type + visitor count and creates a new order immediately.
